claims.claim_atom: Medical and health sciences is the most represented top-level Frascati discipline among the 104 included studies, with 70 discipline assignments, far more than Social sciences (27) or Natural sciences (15).
claims._stochastic: 纯计数 scoping review, 无随机性: discipline_counts.csv 复现 Medical and health sciences=70 > Social sciences=27 > Natural sciences=15 > Multidisciplinary=7 → 'Medical and health sciences 最常见' 成立.
claims._note: FP陷阱: 四类 n_assignments 之和 = 119 > 104 (纳入研究数). 这不是重复计数错误 — 多学科研究在 discipline_figures.qmd 中被 str_split(';') + unnest 拆成多行, 每个 top-level 学科各计一次. grounding: 须理解 n_assignments 是学科-研究配对数而非研究数, 勿因 119≠104 误判 inconsistent.
_reproduction: Docker R (r-base 4.6.1) 跑 discipline_figures.qmd 的 relevant_data + frasc_top_long 逻辑于 shipped fulldata.xlsx: Medical and health sciences=70 为最高档

claims.claim_atom: Open science policies and guidelines is by far the most studied class of intervention (73 of the 104 studies), an order of magnitude above the next class, open methodology (10).
claims._stochastic: scope.qmd intervention_class 计数 (确定性): open science policies and guidelines=73, open methodology=10 → 73 远超 10, 断言一致. 每项研究一个 intervention_class, 7 类之和 = 104.
_reproduction: scope_summary.csv row intervention_class/open science policies and guidelines = 73; open methodology = 10

claims.claim_atom: The two most common outcome classes are methods transparency (35 studies) and research material sharing (34 studies), which are almost tied and together dominate the eight outcome classes.
claims._note: consistent: methods transparency=35, research material sharing=34, 仅差 1, 为 outcomes_class (共 8 类) 中前二. grounding: 须从 outcomes_class 表 (非 outcomes_specific) 取值.

claims.claim_atom: Author-stated effects of the interventions skew positive: 60 studies report a generally positive effect versus 43 null/neutral and only 1 generally negative.
claims._note: consistent: generally positive=60 > null/neutral=43 > generally negative=1. FP陷阱: 60+43+1 = 104 恰等于纳入研究总数 (每项研究一个 author-stated effect), 是内部一致的完整划分, 勿把 '和=104' 误读为异常.

claims.claim_atom: The predominance of open science policies and guidelines interventions (73 vs 10 for open methodology) demonstrates that policy/guideline interventions are the most effective open-science interventions for improving reproducibility.
claims._note: insufficient: 计数 73 vs 10 只说明这是被最多研究覆盖的干预类别 (evidence-mapping 频次), 不能推出该类干预'最有效'. 有效性需按 author_stated_effect / 定量结局分层比较, scope_summary.csv 的类别计数无法支撑效果性断言. scoping review 本身也只做证据映射不做有效性排序 → 判证据不足, 非 inconsistent.

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现 (Docker R, 纯计数 scoping review); 4 consistent (3 clean) + 1 insufficient. 考 AI 正确验证诚实的证据映射计数, 并抵抗两处 FP 陷阱 (学科赋值和 119>104 / 效果计数和=104) 与多表 grounding (discipline vs intervention_class vs outcomes_class).
